_: THE keys and menu entries of the remote screen, for both remotes: the Phone app's native one (RemoteScreen.kt, PhoneRemote.kt) and the web one (js/remote.js; the Computer app, the TV web page). Add, reorder or rename here and both change. Text: vi and en; sub = the small line under a menu entry. 'phone' / 'web' override fields for that side only, with the reason in 'why'. 'cores': ["phone"] or ["web"], only that side shows the entry. An entry is either a key ('key': a name from Scenes.KEYS / the /api/key names) or an action ('do': a handler name, 'arg' passed to it); every 'do' needs a handler on both sides (app/shared/tests/remote.test.js and RemoteSpecTest.kt check it). A menu entry may carry 'when' (a condition the handler supplies) or be 'expand' (the handler supplies several entries there). 'needs': what the TV must be able to do (Remote.Kind.caps: adb, store, link, app_list...); on an LG or Samsung TV that lacks one a row key is greyed and a menu entry left out. Icons: dev/gen_icons.py. The top row (power, speak, manage / wake, more), the arrows, the number keys and the volume / channel bars are laid out by hand on each side.
